The basilica that shares its saint with San Pietro in Ciel d’Oro is **Saint Peter’s Basilica in Rome** (the Church of the Holy See).  
The territory on which that basilica stands was made a sovereign state as **Vatican City** by the **Lateran Treaty** signed with Italy.

- **Signed:** 11 February 1929  
- **Effective/ratified:** 7 June 1929  

Thus, Vatican City—home to Saint Peter’s Basilica—became its own independent country on **11 February 1929** (legal sovereignty coming into force 7 June 1929).
